negative_controls.description: Perturb drift_detector to always accept. FN must rise; the unmutated gate must stay silent on labelled identical/EOL-only pairs.
negative_controls.good_state_output: base FN=0.0 on labelled DIVERGED-negative pairs

negative_controls.description: A 3+3 slice of drift_detector must be SAMPLE-TOO-SMALL with a null threshold, never a rounded percentage.
negative_controls.good_state_output: full 20+20 slice publishes a threshold only at min_sample

gates.false_negative_definition: Predicate accepts a labelled incomplete artifact (silent on known-bad).
gates.false_positive_definition: Predicate rejects a labelled complete artifact (fires on known-good).
gates.title: completion predicate

gates.false_negative_definition: Scanner is silent on a credential-class path or a blocking secret shape.
gates.false_positive_definition: Scanner flags a non-credential path or a file with no blocking secret shape.
gates.title: credential scanner

gates.false_negative_definition: Router returned no SELECTED candidate on a labelled matching query.
gates.false_positive_definition: Router SELECTED a capability on a labelled no-fit query.
gates.title: capability router

gates.false_negative_definition: Overlap primitive misses a paraphrase pair that shares its token set.
gates.false_positive_definition: Overlap primitive flags a disjoint-token pair as near-duplicate.
gates.title: near duplicate detector

gates.false_negative_definition: Classifier fails to report DIVERGED when both sides hold unique lines.
gates.false_positive_definition: Classifier reports DIVERGED on identical bytes or EOL-only difference.
gates.title: drift detector

observations.method: slice n=3 per class below min_sample_per_class
observations.name: undersize_control.decision

report.question: Give spec line 11130 a number: for each shipped gate that can misfire (completion predicate, credential scanner, capability router, near-duplicate detector, drift detector), what are the measured false-positive and false-negative rates on labelled fixtures, with denominators and intervals, and what promote threshold follows?

sample_too_small_control.flag: n_good=3 n_bad=3 below min_sample_per_class=20; threshold not assigned and not rounded

retry.policy: no blind retry; re-runs are flake measurement
